name: skill-marketplace
description: Claude Code plugin marketplace in five plugins, one per kind of work. software takes a change from idea to production: specs, architecture and DDD with Blueprint diagrams, codebase priming and AGENTS.md, a planned build pipeline, review and verification, security and shipping, with principles and stack references as router skills. design builds UX/UI with measured accessibility and quality gates. game designs, reviews and builds games, with a Godot kit. agents builds AI agents, skills, MCP servers, multi-agent fleets and trained models. work covers research, decisions, data, writing and other knowledge work. Vendored skills are supply-chain-controlled copies, each credited in its plugin's NOTICE.md.

plugins.name: software
plugins.description: Take a change from idea to production, in one plugin. Decide: interview-me, grilling, spec, requirement-convergence. Shape: ddd runs the nine-step DDD Starter Modelling Process with validators, a review page, diagrams and recorded decisions; Blueprint renders architecture, sequence, workflow, data-flow and lifecycle diagrams; ADRs, contracts, module design. Understand: core primes a repo with a knowledge graph and keys keeps one AGENTS.md tree; trace, research-codebase, deepwiki, explain-diff. Build: a planned pipeline from brainstorm to change-description, with tdd, debug, swarm and unlazy. Verify: code-sweep review, complexity, blast radius, verify-feature, harnesses and test suites. Secure: security-sweep. Ship: ship-gate, SLOs, flags, CI/CD, migrations. Principles and stack references are router skills that load one guide at a time. The DDD and Blueprint tools require Node.js 18 or newer. Vendored skills are credited in NOTICE.md.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: How should it look and feel? A design-system spine with the design-critic agent: house rules (design-doctrine), DTCG design tokens in three tiers, brand kits, a token build, governance, migration to or from external design systems, Figma sync and DESIGN.md; component, screen and dashboard design with any-framework code generation, image-to-code, redesign and fidelity prototypes; UX writing. Directions against generated-looking UI: frontend-design, impeccable, hallmark, ui-ux-pro-max, Emil Kowalski's design engineering and 138 named design systems. Gates that measure instead of claim: contrast, states, axe, keyboard, target size, overflow, reduced motion and responsive behaviour in light and dark; WCAG 2.2 audits, screen-reader testing and Core Web Vitals. Critique with a Rams lens, design review and plan-design-review. Adapted from plugin87/ux-ui-agent-skills (MIT) and vendored skills; see NOTICE.md.

plugins.name: game
plugins.description: Make a game, from idea to release. A design studio: ideation, fun targeting, core loop, systems and economy, progression, levels and UX, art direction, a game brief, a prototype plan, design diagrams and a one-page design as HTML, SVG and PDF. A review board backed by cited rules from 38 game-development books: game-studio-cpo and auditors for systems, balance, code, performance and QA. A Godot build kit: scripted bots and balance models, upgrade trees, feature seams and save migrations, headless runs and tests, frame-cost measurement, rendered-frame checks, pixel art, audio, release builds and store pages, and habits for a worker fleet.

plugins.name: agents
plugins.description: Build AI systems. Agents: loop-design-check, agent-architecture-audit, autoresearch-agent, cli-for-agents, writing-for-agents and llm-friendly-context, model-router. Skills and servers: skill-creator, mcp-builder, harvest and book-to-skill. Fleets: herdr-orchestrator, herdr-worker, herdr-atomic and herdr-setup run a multi-agent worker fleet through the horch CLI. Models: decide whether to fine-tune, build the eval harness first, curate datasets, LoRA/QLoRA, preference optimisation, GRPO/RLVR, checkpoint promotion, and RAG and recommender pipeline design. skill-creator and mcp-builder are owned copies of Apache-2.0 skills from anthropics/skills; vendored skills are credited in NOTICE.md.

plugins.name: work
plugins.description: Knowledge work, research and decisions, for work that is not code. Decide and research: office-hours, prfaq, plan-ceo-review, roast, deep-research, litreview, deepread, synthesize-research, scientific-problem-selection. Data: profile a dataset, QA an analysis, SQL across warehouse dialects, statistics and A/B tests, Python charts, an offline HTML dashboard. Product operations: metrics reviews, roadmap and stakeholder updates, competitive briefs, market sizing, startup metrics, variance analysis. Support and legal: ticket triage, escalations, contract review, NDA triage. Writing: technical-writing as the entry, with clear-prose and writing-guideline checks, humanize, READMEs and questionnaires. Media and files: HTML slide decks, ffmpeg video editing, file conversion, Mochi flashcard decks and a grounded knowledge vault. Vendored skills are credited in NOTICE.md.
